explorer.title: The Explorer
explorer.body: This is where music comes in: a download from a link, or an import of a folder you already have. History and metadata tell you what arrived.

arche.title: The Arche
arche.body: Your library, on five shelves: tracks, albums, artists, genres and categories. Everything that comes in ends up here.

playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.body: Your own lists, next to what the library sorts by itself. The + creates a new one.

chrome.title: Help and settings
chrome.body: The question mark opens the guide in your browser; the gear opens the settings — and brings you back where you were.

player.title: The player
player.body: Playback lives at the bottom, on every page: the current track, the queue, shuffle and repeat.

finale.title: That's it!
finale.body: You can replay this tour from Settings → Appearance. And to go further, the guide is waiting on the website.
